title: Screenshot review
description: What an agent read from a batch of screenshots. Report only what is visible. Use null or "unclear" rather than guessing; src/parsers/ReceiptParser.js decides what gets written.

kind.description: receipt: a single completed-or-attempted payment or transfer from a supported bank. other: anything else, including balance screens and movement lists.

status.description: success only when the screen explicitly shows the operation completed.

direction.description: From the point of view of the account owner.

amount.description: Positive decimal number, as shown. 65.000,00 is 65000.

currency.description: As shown: VES for Bs, USDT for Binance Pay.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm or YYYY-MM-DD, as shown on the receipt. Not the time of the screenshot.

reference.description: The bank reference or Binance Pay order id, exactly as shown.
